description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds, by passing part of its corrupted body through a foe's body as a standard action, if she hits (+12 touch), the shadow elemental inflicts 7d6 points of shadow damage. This damage manifests in the form of physical wounds and aches from supernatural aging. Creatures immune to magical aging are immune to this damage, but otherwise the damage bypasses all forms of damage reduction. A Fortitude save (DC 21) halves the damage inflicted. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).

effect: Half on save; bypass DR, no damage to creatures immune to magical aging.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).

description.value: When a shadow elemental deals shadow damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be dimmed for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.

effect: For each creature dealt dark damage, including spells. Failure: dimmed for one round.

saveDCs.raw: No printed DC; generated from default monster DC.

description.value: A shadow elemental can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by deeper darkness.

contextNotes.text: Can see perfectly in darkness, including magical darkness.
Can see perfectly in darkness, including magical darkness.

description.value: In any condition of illumination other than full daylight, a shadow elemental disappears into the shadows, giving it concealment (20% miss chance). Artificial illumination, even a light spell, does not negate this ability, a daylight spell, however, does. A shadow elemental can suspend or resume this ability as a free action.

effect: Gain 20% concealment outside full daylight. Daylight spell suppresses; ordinary artificial light does not.

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds, the shadow elemental causes her foe to be silent. She can make a ranged touch attack (+14), hitting a foe up to 30 feet away. The subject takes 5d6 points of shadow damage and the target must make a Will save (DC 21) or be inflicted with Silence status effect for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

effect: Save negates only Silence for [[1d4]] rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

description.value: 20% miss chance, only while active outside daylight.
